concepts: ay represents long a in the taught word set.

workedExamples.prompt: Read “day”. Which spelling is the target focus?
workedExamples.solution: The target spelling is ay; read the whole word using the taught sound long a.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner misreads “play”. What should be checked?

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
